response.overview: Ruth Sawyer and her sweetheart, Ralph, find themselves battling her unscrupulous guardian, who is determined to seize her fortune. As they confront a series of dangerous schemes and life-threatening situations, a mysterious veiled figure intervenes, adding intrigue to their struggle. Romance, suspense, and startling cliffhangers unfold as the couple fights to protect Ruth's inheritance and uncover the mystery surrounding their enigmatic visitor.
response.title: The Veiled Mystery
